newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit hits 38-month low against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit hits 38-month low against dollar.

text.p: The ringgit hit a 38-month low against the dollar late on Friday, on dollar short-covering by corporate players as well as continued speculative selling of the Malaysian currency, dealers said.
At 1030 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.6310/60 to a dollar, its weakest level since May 1994.
Dollar/ringgit had traded below the 2.6000 level in the morning.
Dealers said currency movements were exaggerated by thin trading and wide spreads.
"We are seeing 50 and even 80 points spread. That's why it's moving up so fast," said a European bank dealer. "You can move the market with just a few (million) dollars."
He said the sharp rise sparked off "some panic dollar covering by genuine buyers".
Dealers said the next target for dollar/ringgit is at 2.6500.
